signalLimitations.bodyAttached: DOM attachment of body for non-equivalent deployment context only
signalLimitations.mapCanvasAttached: DOM attachment of .maplibregl-canvas; this is not MapLibre style load
signalLimitations.mapReady: data-map-ready=true set synchronously inside the active MapLibre load event handler
signalLimitations.mapStyleReady: same MapLibre style load boundary as mapReady, retained under an explicit name
signalLimitations.mapOverviewReady: overview source/layers and interactions installed after style load
signalLimitations.mapDetailReady: selected event sources/layers validated and installed; external tiles may still be settling
signalLimitations.mapBasemapRestored: replacement style plus cached app-owned layers and visibility restored
signalLimitations.mapPreviewLoaded: load completion of map_preview.png when the browser requests it; null means it was not fetched in the measured phase
signalLimitations.networkQuiet: No tracked HTTP(S) request in flight for the quiet window; third-party map traffic may affect it
signalLimitations.scriptAttribution: CDP task/script duration and Long Tasks are page-level, not per-chunk execution attribution
